questions.question: Which firm provided $1.4 million in debt as part of Bia Health's $2.15-million financing?
questions.explanation: Finalta Capital supplied $1.4 million in debt, while Anges Québec led the equity portion and Desjardins participated through its Startup en résidence program.

questions.question: Which task will students in the new Cyber Clinics Canada network not handle?
questions.explanation: Students will support assessments, training, planning, and compliance work, but the program says they will not handle active cyberattacks.
questions.sourceLabel: BetaKit — launch of Cyber Clinics Canada

questions.question: Which platform will aggregate, standardize, and enrich confirmed fraud intelligence for CSAFE participants?
questions.explanation: CSAFE participants will share confirmed fraud intelligence through EnStream, which will aggregate, standardize, and enrich the data for participating institutions.
questions.sourceLabel: MobileSyrup — launch of the CSAFE anti-fraud initiative

questions.question: How many roles did Lightspeed say were affected by its latest organizational changes, including vacant roles being closed?
questions.explanation: Lightspeed said 250 roles were affected, a total that included both layoffs and vacant positions that the company closed.

questions.question: Which Tencore uncrewed ground vehicle does Dominion Dynamics plan to manufacture in Canada?
questions.explanation: The agreement calls for Dominion Dynamics to manufacture Tencore's modular TerMIT vehicle and integrate Dominion's AuraNet command-and-control platform.
questions.sourceLabel: BetaKit — Dominion Dynamics' agreement with Tencore

questions.question: What would the international AI body proposed by more than 400 scientists record and track?
questions.explanation: The open letter proposes an international body to standardize AI containment practices and record and track containment failures.
questions.sourceLabel: BetaKit — scientists' call for an international AI regulator

questions.question: Approximately how many Phoenix-area homes will Promise Robotics support under its agreement with DR Horton?
questions.explanation: The multi-year agreement will use Promise Robotics' technology and factory-as-a-service capabilities to support production of more than 1,250 homes.
questions.sourceLabel: BetaKit — Promise Robotics' DR Horton agreement

questions.question: Which province added the most EV charging stations in Canada during the third quarter of 2026?
questions.explanation: Quebec led the country with 49 new stations, ahead of Ontario's 22 and British Columbia's 18.
questions.sourceLabel: MobileSyrup — Canada's Q3 2026 EV charging additions
